title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a residual plot to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app shows residuals as bars on the scatter plot but has no residual-versus-rain view, which Session 2 relies on.

## Context
A residual plot is the first thing to look at after any fit (QUALITY.md, item 3: meaningful graphs).

## Expected outcome
A third view that plots residual (t/ha) against rainfall (100 mm) with a zero line.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Labelled axes with units
- [ ] Residuals update when the sliders move

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add leave-one-out cross-validation to Session 3
body:
## Problem
Session 3 has k-fold cross-validation but not the leave-one-out special case (k = n).

## Context
Leave-one-out has a closed form for least squares and ridge; comparing it with the k-fold choice is instructive.

## Expected outcome
A `loo_cv` function and a check that it picks a lambda close to the 5-fold choice.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Function and check added
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 4: intervals when the noise grows
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The Session 2 interval assumes the same spread everywhere.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: four panels that tell the overfitting story
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a growing polynomial, a U-shaped test-error curve, a ridge path and a flaring prediction band; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All four panels animate
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
